## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The missing-results fallback allows releases without saved checks and should be fixed before merge. Existing tests cover saved pass/fail results but miss this failure path.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — When results.json is missing, returning [] makes release_allowed() return True because all([]) is True. Preserve the exception or explicitly reject release when results are absent. — Releases can proceed without any recorded successful checks.
